measured.method: 200 random (part, row, seed) cells from standard.expand(), 40 per category, seed 12345, 60 s cell timeout; cost = mean record wall + timeouts at cap + cold-prep share, in worker-seconds per cell
measured.note: CI ubuntu-latest (4 vCPUs) is slower; shard plans target half the cap so a ~1.5x slowdown still fits
